QuestInfo.name: [Zombie Survival] The Outbreak
QuestInfo.0: The zombie virus is spreading. Talk to the Disease Control Agent.
QuestInfo.1: The agent might have maybe accidentally infected you a little. Good thing they had that Basic Vaccine to give you.
QuestInfo.2:
#e#r<Zombie Virus Warning>#k#n
1) You must cure yourself with the vaccine within #e#b30 minutes#k#n of infection.
2) If you do not cure yourself, you will become a #e#rZombie#k#n.
3) You get special powers as a zombie, but you must cure yourself within #e#b10 minutes#k#n.
4) If you still don't cure yourself, you will become a #e#rHost#k#n.
5) Hosts do not look like zombies, but they can #k#nspread#k#n the virus.
